question: Which one of the following is the official language of Goa?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Konkani.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Konkani **is an **Indo-Aryan language** spoken predominantly in the Konkan region of India, which includes **Goa, Maharashtra, and Karnataka.**
 
• It is the** official language** of the Indian state of Goa and is also recognized as a **minority language** in the states of Karnataka and Maharashtra.
 
• Konkani has several dialects, including **Goan Konkani, Mangalorean Konkani, and Malvani Konkani.**
 
• The script used to write Konkani varies depending on the** region and community.**
 
• In Goa, it is written in the **Devanagari script,** while in Maharashtra and Karnataka, it is written in the** Kannada script.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kokborok** is a Tibeto-Burman language.

 
 
• It is spoken in the Indian state of **Tripura **and parts of **Bangladesh.**
 
 
 
• **Khamti **is a **Tai language.**
 
 
• It is spoken in parts of **Myanmar** and India's** Arunachal Pradesh **state.
 
 
 
• **Tamang** is a **Tibeto-Burman** language.
 
 
• It is spoken in** Nepal, India, and Bhutan.**
